user.title: Drone monitoring nearby
user.description: Pick the point and radius where you want to know about registered drone flights. Data comes from the PANSA DroneTower system. Since August 2026 the API requires a login — enter the email and password of the DroneTower/PansaUTM account you use in the app.

init.title: Monitoring settings
init.description: Flight history is stored locally. A pilot's phone number is published only with their consent — about a third of check-ins — and it is the only identifier linking two flights to the same person.

data.include_planned: Include registered flights that have not started yet
data.include_overdue: Include overdue check-ins (usually left open by the pilot)
data.history_days: Days of flight history to keep

data_description.store_phone_numbers: Without this you can still count returning operators, but you will not see a number. Enabling it also puts the number into the "Last flight" sensor's attributes, and from there into the recorder database and every backup — permanently, with no easy undo. It never reaches the integration's own events. Turning it off deletes numbers from the integration's history, but not from the recorder database.
